description: This file contains functions and variables for platform-specific upgrade procedures for embedded devices, particularly wireless routers. It defines how to perform upgrades based on different board types and manages related environment variables.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: A stub function that currently always returns success, indicating the image is valid.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs firmware upgrade depending on the board's name by calling specific upgrade functions.
